```{r define import function}
import_parsed_vcfs <- function(path) {
  # collect .parsed or .parsed.bed files
  if (dir.exists(path)) {
    files <- list.files(path, pattern = "\\.parsed(?:\\.bed)?$", full.names = TRUE)
  } else {
    files <- path
  }
  if (length(files) == 0) stop("No parsed BED files found.")
  
  df_list <- list()
  for (f in files) {
    df <- read.table(f, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    fname <- basename(f)
    
    # strip trailing .parsed or .parsed.bed
    core <- sub("\\.parsed(?:\\.bed)?$", "", fname)
    
    parts <- strsplit(core, "\\.", perl=TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(parts) < 2) {
      warning(sprintf("Skipping '%s': doesn't look like assembly.animal.parsed", fname))
      next
    }
    
    # last part = animal; everything else = assembly
    animal   <- parts[length(parts)]
    assembly <- paste(parts[-length(parts)], collapse = ".")
    
    df$assembly <- assembly
    df$animal   <- animal
    df_list[[f]] <- df
  }
  
  combined_df <- do.call(rbind, df_list)
  combined_df
}
```

```{r define epdf generation function}
# Define a function factory that returns an empirical PDF function.
create_epdf <- function(data, bw = "nrd0", from = NULL, to = NULL, n = 512) {
  # Build a list of arguments for density()
  args <- list(x = data, bw = bw, n = n)
  if (!is.null(from)) {
    args$from <- from
  }
  if (!is.null(to)) {
    args$to <- to
  }
  
  # Compute the kernel density estimate using the conditional arguments
  dens <- do.call(density, args)
  
  # Create an interpolation function based on the density estimates.
  # rule = 2 makes the function use the boundary values for extrapolation.
  epdf_function <- approxfun(dens$x, dens$y, rule = 2)
  
  # Return the function (closure) so you can later pass values to it.
  return(epdf_function)
}
```

```{r import all and save epdf functions}
# Loop through the parsed VCFs, import each, generate an epdf, then save the epdf to a file.

for (file in dir("Parsed_VCFs/")) {
  # Define file path  
  path<- paste0("Parsed_VCFs/", file)
  
  print(paste0("Processing file: ", path))
  # Import the parsed VCF
  import_parsed_vcfs(path)->pileupData
  
  # filter out rows with NA in allele_fraction
  pileupData <- pileupData %>% filter(!is.na(allele_fraction))
  
  # Generate the epdf
  epdf_pileup <- create_epdf(pileupData$allele_fraction)
  
  # Save the epdf to a file
  outputfile<-paste0("epdf_", file, ".rds")
  saveRDS(epdf_pileup, file = outputfile)
  
}
```

```{r import all and save ecdf functions}
# Loop through the parsed VCFs, import each, generate an ecdf, then save the ecdf to a file.

for (file in dir("Parsed_VCFs/")) {
  # Define file path  
  path<- paste0("Parsed_VCFs/", file)
  
  print(paste0("Processing file: ", path))
  # Import the parsed VCF
  import_parsed_vcfs(path)->pileupData
  
  # filter out rows with NA in allele_fraction
  pileupData <- pileupData %>% filter(!is.na(allele_fraction))
  
  # Generate the ecdf
  ecdf_pileup <- ecdf(pileupData$allele_fraction)
  
  # Save the ecdf to a file
  outputfile<-paste0("ecdf_", file, ".rds")
  saveRDS(ecdf_pileup, file = outputfile)
}
```
